ideas.pitch: A localized energy consumption forecasting tool tailored for South Carolina university campuses to predict peak load and reduce carbon footprints.
ideas.title: Palmetto Campus Energy Grid Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of winning predictive infrastructure projects like the AI incident forecasting tool by utilizing rigorous backtesting and local dataset relevance.

ideas.pitch: An explainable risk-scoring dashboard for local merchants in Columbia to detect suspicious transactions using lightweight graph intelligence.
ideas.title: Palmetto Small Business Fraud Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the core architecture of award-winning financial AML platforms into a scoped, highly visual product that judges can test instantly.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent platform facilitating direct transactions between local South Carolina farmers and buyers with secure escrow guarantees.
ideas.title: SC Ag-Marketplace Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture of the Synthesis Hackathon winner by combining autonomous coordination with concrete transaction settlements.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient onboarding and trust engine customized for regional community clinics in South Carolina to streamline intake workflows.
ideas.title: Palmetto Community Health Intake
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses the fast-turnaround pattern of the Global-Smile prize-winning project, focusing on an immediate operational bottleneck for local service providers.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent support network utilizing RAG to connect university students in Columbia with campus resources and peer support guidance.
ideas.title: Palmetto Student Mental Health Multi-Agent Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of the GreenNovation Hackathon winner by structuring complex multi-agent workflows into a clean user interface.
